title: Event envelope v1
description: Common envelope for every cross-service event. Served by each producer's GET /v1/events feed from its transactional outbox.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Consumers de-duplicate on it (inbox table).

producer.description: Platform service that wrote the event, or 'studio' for a studio game server (its events are signed; see round-outcome-recorded).

operatorCode.description: Tenant. Null only for platform-wide events (e.g. a game killed for all operators).

partitionKey.description: Ordering key: events with the same key are delivered in order (round id, player id or game code).

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the request that caused the event.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units (cents). Never a float.
